correctness.rationale: Stationary SIQS balances give an exact two-dimensional logistic positive-map fixed point. At critical tuning the strictly positive mixing matrix has determinant 1, trace greater than 2, hence Perron root greater than 1. A small Perron subsolution and unit supersolution give existence, strict subhomogeneity proves uniqueness. Rescaling the stationary relations by epsilon^(1/3) and epsilon^(2/3) gives U^2=BW, W^2=CU; the positive solution is unique and has Jacobian determinant 3BC>0, so implicit-function theorem gives the asserted powers and constants. The full six-compartment reconstruction has nonnegative components; independently computed rational and high precision residual checks passed. The finite tests are corroboration, not a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: For a doubly critical, fully coupled vaccination-homophily epidemic, a population minority of size epsilon induces global endemic prevalence of order epsilon^(2/3), asymptotically larger than its own population share. Exact exponents for the two groups and their coefficients expose nonlinear cross-group persistence hidden by linear threshold criteria; the shape and normalization of the risk amplification have mathematical and epidemic-model interpretation. This is a parameterized structural singular-limit theorem, not a textbook renaming or an arbitrary finite sample.
